Title: Email Delivery Not Implemented (Commented Stub)
Evidence: Resend/SMTP call is commented out in code; resend package not in package.json; no emails sent even with valid env vars.
Impact: Client project enquiries from /start-a-project are never delivered to founders.
Recommended_Fix: Install resend package, implement transactional email dispatch, configure SPF/DKIM DNS records.
Verification_Status: Verified via code inspection and API simulation

Title: Client-Controlled Header Rate Limiting Bypass
Evidence: Rate limiter derives IP from raw x-forwarded-for header without trusted proxy validation; spoofing header bypasses limit.
Impact: Attackers and spam bots can bypass rate limiting by rotating custom X-Forwarded-For headers.
Recommended_Fix: Validate client IP against trusted reverse proxy or use host-level platform rate limiting.

Title: Missing Open Graph Default Image Asset (/og-default.jpg)
Evidence: Metadata references /og-default.jpg as fallback, but file does not exist in /public; returns 404.
Impact: Social sharing preview cards on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, and Slack will show broken images.
Recommended_Fix: Create and add branded 1200x630px og-default.jpg in /public directory.
Verification_Status: Verified via filesystem and HTTP fetch

Title: Founder Name, Biography, and Portrait Photograph Unpopulated
Evidence: siteConfig.founder has placeholder name 'Founder', empty bio and photo; UI renders 'Founder biography to be added'.
Impact: Studio appears unfinished and anonymous to prospective enterprise and international clients.
Recommended_Fix: Founder must approve real name, professional biography, and upload portrait photograph.
Verification_Status: Verified via code and UI inspection

Title: WhatsApp Number Unconfigured Displays Placeholder Notice
Evidence: When NEXT_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER is empty, contact page renders 'WhatsApp number — to be configured'.
Impact: Unconfigured contact method displayed visibly to site visitors, reducing credibility.
Recommended_Fix: Populate real E.164 WhatsApp number in .env.local or hide card when number is unset.

Title: In-Memory Rate Limiter Not Distributed Across Server Instances
Evidence: Rate limiter uses in-memory JavaScript Map; state is isolated per process/serverless lambda.
Impact: In serverless or clustered deployments, rate limiting fails across concurrent lambdas.
Recommended_Fix: Implement distributed rate limiting using Upstash Redis or Cloudflare/Vercel edge KV.

Title: Missing HTTP Security Headers & X-Powered-By Information Disclosure
Evidence: next.config.ts has no security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options); X-Powered-By is sent.
Impact: Increases vulnerability to clickjacking, MIME sniffing, and technology profiling.
Recommended_Fix: Add poweredByHeader: false and security headers in next.config.ts.

Title: Vulnerabilities in Transitive Build/Dev Dependencies
Evidence: npm audit reports 7 vulnerabilities (6 high, 1 moderate) in transitive postcss and braces packages.
Impact: Potential arbitrary file disclosure via malformed source maps and dev-time regex DoS.
Recommended_Fix: Update Next.js and ESLint to latest patch releases once verified.

Title: Honeypot Spam Protection Missing
Evidence: Form and API route lack honeypot fields despite claims in previous delivery documentation.
Impact: Automated spam bots can spam the enquiry form unchecked by honeypot traps.
Recommended_Fix: Add hidden honeypot input in form and validate emptiness on server.

Title: JSON-LD Structured Data Missing
Evidence: Previous delivery report claimed valid JSON-LD; grep confirms no application/ld+json exists in project.
Impact: Search engines cannot parse rich snippets for Organization, WebSite, or ProfessionalService.
Recommended_Fix: Add Schema.org JSON-LD script tag in root layout.
Verification_Status: Verified via code search and DOM inspection

Title: Muted Text Fails WCAG AA Normal Text Contrast
Evidence: --color-text-muted (#666666) on canvas (#080808) produces 3.49:1 contrast (below 4.5:1 required for normal text).
Impact: Small labels, dates, and secondary metadata may be unreadable for users with visual impairments.
Verification_Status: Mathematically verified via relative luminance formula

Title: Browser Automated Visual and Screen-Reader Testing Incomplete
Evidence: Playwright loopback connection to 127.0.0.1:3000 failed with net::ERR_ABORTED in container sandbox.
Impact: Visual rendering across viewports (320px to 1920px) verified via static code inspection only.
Recommended_Fix: Conduct manual cross-browser testing on physical devices before commercial launch.

Title: Root Homepage Missing Canonical Link Tag
Evidence: Root layout does not set alternates: { canonical: '/' }; link rel='canonical' absent from HTML.
Impact: Potential search engine confusion if domain is accessed with or without trailing slash/query parameters.
Recommended_Fix: Add alternates: { canonical: '/' } to metadata in root layout.

Title: No Automated Test Suite Configured
Evidence: No test script or test runner (Jest, Vitest, Playwright) is configured in package.json.
Impact: Future code changes and refactors cannot be validated automatically in CI/CD.
Recommended_Fix: Add Vitest for unit tests and Playwright for end-to-end integration tests.

Title: Privacy Notice Uses Standard Anchor Tags for Internal Contact Link
Evidence: src/app/privacy/page.tsx uses standard a href='/contact' instead of Next.js Link.
Impact: Forces full browser page refresh instead of client-side SPA soft navigation.
Recommended_Fix: Replace a href='/contact' with Next.js Link component.
